comparator.name: International Bachelor Econometrics and Operations Research
comparator.sourceNotes: The official English-taught programme is the international variant of the Dutch Econometrics and Operations Research bachelor. The current 2026-2027 programme overview confirms the same three-year, 180-EC mathematical, statistical, programming, economics, econometrics and operations-research structure, followed by third-year profiling and a bachelor thesis. The neutral Econometrics major remains the broadest continuation of the common core.
components: Case Studies in Econometrics and Operations Research
Open School elective space alongside the selected third-year route.
One seminar/workgroup plus two major courses in the selected Econometrics route.
Bachelor Thesis Econometrics and Operations Research

courses: Business & Economy in the Age of AI

core: Operations research, optimisation and decision models
Research practice, academic skills and ethics
questions: How can real economic and business problems be translated into mathematical models and optimised?
How can data be used to estimate, forecast and support decisions under uncertainty?

alternatives.label: Quantitative economics, econometrics & optimisation
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum is organised around economics, econometrics and optimisation, supported by mathematics, statistics, programming, algorithms and data analysis; the label avoids presenting UCR as offering the comparator's full specialist econometrics sequence.
alternatives.concept: A closest feasible response to Econometrics and Operations Research built around mathematics, statistics, econometrics, economics, programming, algorithms and optimisation.
progression: Programming, economics and corporate-finance foundations begin in Semester 1. Mathematical Methods, Research Methods and introductory data science precede the mathematics, statistics, econometrics and advanced data work. Algorithms & Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms; optimisation follows programming and the main mathematical foundations, while reinforcement learning is reserved for the final semester after programming and machine learning. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Econometrics, data science & predictive modelling
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum retains the econometric and economic core but adds software development, neural networks, AI ethics and AI/business applications, making data science and predictive modelling a visible organising strand rather than calling the whole programme simply Econometrics.
alternatives.concept: A Data Science for Econometrics direction combining econometrics with programming, software development, machine learning, neural networks, algorithms and quantitative economic applications.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest-match curriculum, this route replaces accounting/corporate finance, public economics, numerical methods and general ethics with database management, software development, neural networks, AI ethics and explicit AI/business applications. Those changes make computational data science and predictive modelling, rather than the broad economics-and-operations-research core, the additional organising logic.
progression: Programming, introductory data science and economics begin in Semester 1. Mathematical Methods and Research Methods precede the advanced mathematics, neural networks and econometrics. Algorithms & Data Structures precedes Advanced Algorithms; software development, advanced algorithms, neural networks and the AI/business application course are placed in Year 2 after the foundations. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

alternatives.label: Quantitative economics & finance
alternatives.labelReason: The completed curriculum combines mathematical, statistical and econometric training with accounting, business foundations, banking and finance, macroeconomics and behavioural economics; this supports a finance direction without overstating UCR as offering a full specialist quantitative-finance major.
alternatives.concept: A Quantitative Finance direction combining mathematics, statistics, econometrics and programming with corporate finance, banking, macroeconomics, microeconomics and financial decision-making.
alternatives.distinctness: Compared with the closest-match curriculum, the finance route adds business foundations, database management, Money, Banking & Finance and behavioural economics while dropping advanced algorithms, logic and discrete mathematics, optimisation and reinforcement learning. Those changes shift the curricular centre toward financial and economic decision-making. It differs still more clearly from the data-science route through its accounting, banking, public-economics and behavioural-economics content.
progression: Business foundations precede Money, Banking & Finance. Mathematical Methods precedes linear algebra, probability, advanced calculus and numerical methods; Research Methods precedes the advanced economics and econometrics courses; programming precedes algorithms and computational decision-making. Every formal prerequisite occurs earlier and every course is offered in its assigned term.

routeSelection.basis: The normalized target is the international generic Econometrics and Operations Research bachelor. The current official programme offers four third-year majors. Econometrics most directly continues the common econometric core and is less domain-specific than Data Science for Econometrics, Quantitative Finance or Quantitative Logistics, so it is selected independently of UCR fit.

selection.assessment: The closest match covers the common quantitative economics, econometrics and optimisation core. Data Science for Econometrics and Quantitative Finance are official, coherent and mechanically feasible additional directions. Quantitative Logistics is assessed separately but rejected because UCR lacks sufficient logistics and supply-chain domain content for a distinct 24-course pathway without padding. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.

blocks: Both provide foundational statistical methods; UCR Research Methods & Statistics is broader and more applied than the comparator's dedicated introductory statistics course.
Both cover multivariate statistical analysis; UCR teaches it in a behavioural-science research context rather than an econometrics-specific context.
Both are introductory programming courses; UCR uses Python rather than the comparator's Java-focused implementation.
UCR Optimization Methods in AI covers continuous and global optimisation among broader search and optimisation methods; it is not a one-to-one nonlinear-optimisation syllabus.
Both concern advanced algorithmic solution methods for optimisation problems; UCR is broader than the comparator's dedicated combinatorial-optimisation course.
UCR Introduction to Economics covers both micro- and macroeconomics; this row aligns it only with the comparator's introductory microeconomics component.
Both develop regression-based econometric estimation and empirical analysis; the comparator continues with additional econometrics courses beyond UCR's single dedicated course.
Both provide finance foundations and quantitative financial decision-making, though the UCR course is broader in banking and practical investment decisions.
Both support professional and career development; UCR PPD is a broader personal and professional-development course.
Both provide structured ethical reasoning, but UCR Ethics is general rather than specifically focused on econometrics.

notes.text: UCR does not reproduce the comparator's full specialist sequence in advanced econometrics, time-series analysis, mathematical economics or a dedicated econometrics thesis; those gaps remain visible rather than being filled by weak matches.
